tool_input.summary: Fixed leaf piece jump bug: pieces with a parent but no children were jumping far from the cursor on drag stop due to a coordinate space mismatch. The sketchpad computes the drag offset in center/pixel space (pixels / ICON_WIDTH), but dragPiecesInDesign puts this offset directly as a connection u/v diff. In flattenDesign, connection u/v is multiplied by horizontalScale (3.0633) for horizontal connections, causing the visual position to be amplified ~3x. Fix: after dragPiecesInDesign, scale each connection diff by dividing u/v by the effective scale factor (horizontalScale for horizontal connections, 1 for vertical connections). The scale is determined by looking up the parent connector direction from the kit types. Added a new test that verifies: (1) the scaled diff produces the correct visual position matching the intended pixel offset, and (2) the unscaled diff shows the 3x amplification bug. All 7 Drag + 2 Move tests pass (197 total, 1 pre-existing unrelated failure).
